text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey ran a magnificent race. Her 
unique style backed by Feng Shui 
captivated the eyes of the spectators.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You'd think the next step would be a 
bigger stage――but she is prudent, wanting 
to build real ability first. Feng shui 
isn't an all-powerful miracle; it's merely 
a tool to help bring out one's true 
potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Hokko Tarumae won a graded 
race. Copano Rickey nodded in agreement as 
Tarumae shared how much she valued those 
who helped and supported her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deciding that the next goal would be 
"gathering fans," she also resolved to 
look for Umamusume who could assist with 
her training.
